name: Higgsfield
summary: AI platform for image, video and voice creation with an AI agent.
description: Higgsfield lets creators generate images, videos and voice from prompts or references, then edit, upscale and automate workflows with an AI agent on web and mobile. It aggregates many third-party models (e.g. Kling, Nano Banana) with cinematic presets. A free plan ($0) offers limited models with a watermark; paid plans start with Starter at about $15/month, with prices changing frequently.

pricing.label: Freemium

howToUse.title: Sign up

howToUse.title: Or start from one upload

howToUse.title: Learn the flow in the Academy
howToUse.description: Higgsfield Academy says it teaches AI images and videos step by step.
